9.1.en: Krishna: "Since you don't nitpick, I'll tell you the deepest secret. It'll free you."
9.1.hi: Krishna: "Kyunki tum nukta-cheeni nahi karte, main tumhe sabse gehra raaz batata hoon. Ye tumhe free karega."

9.2.en: This is the king of all knowledge. You can experience it directly, and it's actually enjoyable to practise.
9.2.hi: Ye gyaan ka raja hai. Iska seedha anubhav hota hai, aur practice karne mein maza bhi aata hai.

9.3.en: People with zero faith in this keep going around in the cycle and never reach me.
9.3.hi: Jinhe isme bilkul bharosa nahi, woh cycle mein ghoomte rehte hain aur mujh tak nahi pahunchte.

9.4.en: I'm in everything, unseen. Everything rests in me, but I'm not limited by any of it.
9.4.hi: Main sab mein hoon, bina dikhe. Sab mujh mein tika hai, par main kisi se limited nahi.

9.5.en: I hold everything up, yet I'm not stuck in anything. That's my mystery.
9.5.hi: Main sab ko sambhalta hoon, par kisi mein phansa nahi. Yahi mera rahasya hai.

9.6.en: Like wind moves through the sky but stays in the sky, all beings move within me.
9.6.hi: Jaise hawa aakash mein chalti hai par aakash mein hi rehti hai, waise sab jeev mujh mein chalte hain.

9.7.en: At the end of a cosmic cycle everything returns to me, and at the start I send it out again.
9.7.hi: Cosmic cycle ke ant mein sab mujh mein lautta hai, aur shuru mein main phir se bhejta hoon.

9.8.en: Through nature I create again and again. Beings follow nature's flow.
9.8.hi: Nature ke zariye main baar-baar banata hoon. Jeev nature ke flow ke saath chalte hain.

9.9.en: None of this binds me, because I stay detached. Like a chill observer.
9.9.hi: Ye sab mujhe baandhta nahi, kyunki main detached rehta hoon. Ek chill observer ki tarah.

9.10.en: Under my watch, nature creates everything, and the world keeps turning.
9.10.hi: Meri nigraani mein nature sab banati hai, aur duniya ghoomti rehti hai.

9.11.en: Some people see me in human form and dismiss me. They don't see who I really am.
9.11.hi: Kuch log mujhe insaani roop mein dekh ke ignore kar dete hain. Woh nahi dekhte main asli mein kaun hoon.

9.12.en: Their hopes, actions and knowledge go to waste because they're stuck in a negative mindset.
9.12.hi: Unki umeedein, kaam aur gyaan sab bekaar jaata hai kyunki woh negative mindset mein phanse hain.

9.13.en: Great souls with a divine nature worship me single-mindedly, knowing I'm the source of everything.
9.13.hi: Divine nature wale mahaan log ek-man se meri pooja karte hain, ye jaante hue ki main sabka source hoon.

9.14.en: They keep singing about me, stay committed, and bow with love. Pure devotion.
9.14.hi: Woh mere gun gaate rehte hain, committed rehte hain, aur pyaar se jhukte hain. Shuddh bhakti.

9.15.en: Others worship me through knowledge: as one, as many, as the whole universe.
9.15.hi: Kuch gyaan se meri pooja karte hain: ek roop mein, anek roop mein, poore brahmaand ke roop mein.

9.16.en: I'm the ritual, the offering, the herb, the mantra, the fire and the act of offering. I'm all of it.
9.16.hi: Main ritual, offering, jadi-booti, mantra, aag aur arpan ka kaam hoon. Main sab hoon.

9.17.en: I'm the father, mother and grandparent of the universe. I'm Om, and every sacred text.
9.17.hi: Main brahmaand ka pita, maata aur dada hoon. Main Om hoon, aur har pavitra granth.

9.18.en: I'm the goal, the support, the witness, the home, the refuge and the friend. The start and end of everything.
9.18.hi: Main goal, sahara, saakshi, ghar, sharan aur dost hoon. Sabka shuru aur ant.

9.19.en: I bring heat and rain. I'm life and death, what exists and what doesn't.
9.19.hi: Main garmi aur baarish laata hoon. Main jeevan aur maut, jo hai aur jo nahi, sab hoon.

9.20.en: Some perform rituals to get into heaven. They get there and enjoy divine pleasures.
9.20.hi: Kuch log swarg jaane ke liye rituals karte hain. Woh pahunchte hain aur divya sukh enjoy karte hain.

9.21.en: But when their good-karma balance runs out, they come back. Heaven is a holiday, not a home.
9.21.hi: Par jab punya ka balance khatam hota hai, woh wapas aate hain. Swarg holiday hai, ghar nahi.

9.22.en: Those who focus only on me, I take care of. What they need, I bring. What they have, I protect.
9.22.hi: Jo sirf mujh pe focus karte hain, unka main dhyaan rakhta hoon. Jo chahiye woh laata hoon, jo hai woh bachata hoon.

9.23.en: Even people who worship other gods with faith are really worshipping me, just indirectly.
9.23.hi: Jo dusre devtaon ki bharose se pooja karte hain, woh bhi asli mein meri hi pooja karte hain, bas indirectly.

9.24.en: I'm the one who receives every offering. Not knowing this, people slip back.
9.24.hi: Har offering main hi leta hoon. Ye na jaanne se log wapas fisal jaate hain.

9.25.en: You become what you worship. Worship the gods and you go to them. Worship me and you come to me.
9.25.hi: Jiski pooja karo, wahi ban jaate ho. Devtaon ki karo toh unke paas, meri karo toh mere paas.

9.26.en: A leaf, a flower, a fruit, or some water, given with love: I accept it. It's the heart that counts.
9.26.hi: Ek patta, phool, phal ya thoda paani, pyaar se diya: main sweekar karta hoon. Dil matter karta hai.

9.27.en: Whatever you do, eat, give or practise, offer it to me. Turn your whole life into an offering.
9.27.hi: Jo bhi karo, khao, do ya practice karo, mujhe arpan karo. Poori life ko offering bana do.

9.28.en: Do this and you're freed from good and bad karma alike. Free, you'll come to me.
9.28.hi: Aisa karo toh achhe-bure dono karma se free ho jaoge. Free hokar mere paas aaoge.

9.29.en: I'm the same to everyone. No favourites, no haters. But those who love me live in me, and I in them.
9.29.hi: Main sabke liye same hoon. Na favourite, na dushman. Par jo mujhe pyaar karte hain, woh mujh mein, main un mein.

9.30.en: Even someone who's done terrible things, if they turn to me sincerely, should be seen as good. They've chosen right.
9.30.hi: Jisne bahut galat kiya ho, agar woh dil se meri taraf mude, toh use achha maano. Usne sahi chuna hai.

9.31.en: They change quickly and find lasting peace. Tell the world: my devotee never falls.
9.31.hi: Woh jaldi badalte hain aur lasting peace paate hain. Duniya ko batao: mera bhakt kabhi nahi girta.

9.32.en: Anyone, regardless of birth, gender or class, who turns to me reaches the highest. No exceptions.
9.32.hi: Koi bhi, janam, gender ya class kuch bhi ho, jo meri sharan aata hai, sabse ooncha paata hai. Koi exception nahi.

9.33.en: This world is temporary and full of struggle. So while you're here, connect with me.
9.33.hi: Ye duniya temporary aur struggle bhari hai. Toh jab tak yahan ho, mujhse judo.

9.34.en: Keep your mind on me, love me, honour me, bow to me. Make me your goal and you'll reach me.
9.34.hi: Mind mujh pe rakho, mujhe pyaar karo, izzat do, jhuko. Mujhe goal banao, mujh tak pahunchoge.
